source.title: Adaptive Limits of Algorithmic Cryptocurrency Trading from a Complex Adaptive Systems Perspective: An Empirical Study on Human-AI Collaborative Strategy
source.author: Wonpyo Han, Hansung University
source.access_method: Full uploaded text read; Tables 1/3 and 6/7/8 visually checked

source_sample: Ten selected surviving Binance crypto assets, hourly OHLCV, June 2022 through March 2026; eight retrospective periods; study reports 80 main and over 160 total experiments

quoted_arithmetic.table1_caveat: Residuals 0.12/0.11 pp exceed ordinary rounding of three two-decimal means, if alpha is simple same-sample excess. Definitions/weights require raw reconciliation, not an accusation of fabrication.
quoted_arithmetic.table3_caveat: Implied arithmetic only under simple-excess definition; no independent reconstruction of original strategy returns.
quoted_arithmetic.table8_caveat: Paired p arithmetic agrees with 0.036 under iid pairs; independence, selection correction and chronological strategy validity not established.
quoted_arithmetic.table7_caveat: Arithmetic on reported fee-study means only; no observed spread, fill or native futures cost validation. A low-fee viability threshold is not established by negative means.

owned_input_mapping.method: Filename metadata only; no raw prices or returns loaded
owned_input_mapping.conclusion: Owned BTC series and ETH perpetual 30-minute data do not establish the exact ten-asset Binance hourly universe, V3 formula or sentiment availability. No proxy or new acquisition loop justified.

prior_family: Generic indicator/regime filters overlap existing failed/qualified work; exact study is not falsely called already tested.
